events.evidence: Twenty-six people are killed in Dera Bugti, southwest Pakistan, when their vehicle hits a landmine
The World Health Organization announces that the number of people killed by measles declined by 48%
Italian prosecutors ask for Prime Minister Silvio Berlusconi and British lawyer David Mills to be indicted

label.note: Pakistan landmine deaths and Berlusconi indictment are adverse but localized; WHO measles progress is a mild positive.
